pages.title: Budget for transfers
pages.text: A field can draw up to $(thing)400 of each flux per tick$() and save a small operating reserve.$(br2)Moving one item costs 100 paired units. A stack of 64 costs 226. Batching is efficient once your supplies are reliable.$(br2)Loss of either flux clears that reserve. Keep both generators running for steady transfers.

pages.title: Transfer checklist
pages.text: $(li)Connected markers under nodes.$(li)Enough field height.$(li)Output at source; Input at destination.$(li)Matching filters.$(li)Enough items for the batch.$(li)Free destination space.$(li)Conditions satisfied.$(li)Both fluxes supplied.$(br2)Check inventory counts as well as the animation.
